name: local-proxy-server
title: In-app local proxy server (HTTP CONNECT + SOCKS5)
description: Add an opt-in loopback HTTP/HTTPS-CONNECT and SOCKS5 proxy server inside Ameow desktop so local browsers, system proxy settings and the browser extension can route outbound traffic through Ameow's existing single-precedence network route (manual > system > environment > direct).
creator: wjingshan
notes: Shipped in 668d9b0. Automated verification is green: npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run docs:build, plus 30 socket-level cases (src/config/localProxyServer.test.ts, electron/localProxyUpstream.test.mts, electron/localProxyServer.test.mts). End-to-end verification against the real internet passed with a direct egress route: an HTTP absolute-form GET, a CONNECT tunnel carrying a TLS handshake, and a SOCKS5 CONNECT to example.com all answered HTTP/1.1 200 (3 connections, 0 failures, and the listener released every socket on stop). The manual-proxy upstream path is covered by injected-dial unit tests rather than by a live upstream. The only remaining check needs a GUI session: loading a page in a real browser through the proxy.
